card.name: Stomach in NSAID GI warning list
card.fires_on: The word "stomach" in the NSAID warning list of GI injury sites (esophagus, stomach, small intestine). Also "Conversely" starting a sentence in MAOI/bupropion washout wording.

modes.label: Stomach in GI list
modes.description: "stomach" after "esophagus," in the NSAID warning about bleeding, ulceration and perforation.
modes.example: including naproxen, cause serious gastrointestinal (GI) adverse events including inflammation, bleeding, ulceration, and perforation of the esophagus,<< stomach>>, small intestine, or large intestine,

modes.label: Conversely after MAOI washout
modes.description: Sentence-opening "Conversely" in the MAOI and bupropion 14-day spacing statement.
modes.example: elapse between discontinuation of an MAOI intended to treat depression and initiation of therapy with bupropion hydrobromide extended-release tablets.<< Conversely>>, at least 14 days should
